meta.title: feat: implement lazy loading for Stripe SDK
meta.body_summary: Implement lazy loading for Stripe SDK via a useStripe() hook to reduce initial bundle size and avoid loading Stripe for users who never access payment features.

perf_labels.notes: Devin added lazy Stripe loading; merged <2h with no formal review after maintainer switched to pure import.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1010 changed lines, most bulk comes from a `main` merge that introduced unrelated documentation and infrastructure; the core lazy-loading diff is only 117 lines across 5 files. This small-scope, self-contained frontend performance PR fits a fast-track merge pattern.

review_details.concern_detail: No review feedback recorded; PR was merged directly with a maintainer follow-up commit.
review_details.performance_claim: Lazy loading Stripe SDK reduces initial bundle size and speeds up page loads for users not accessing payment features.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Frontend lazy-loading pattern is a well-understood optimization; Devin executed it with a small, focused change and was accepted without review.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer steebchen reviewed the code and committed a follow-up change to use @stripe/stripe-js/pure for further side-effect elimination.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body describes manual local testing but provides no before/after metrics, bundle analysis, or profiler output.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No performance regression; the maintainer added a small import optimization.

core_change_summary.description: Created useStripe() hook in apps/ui/src/lib/stripe.ts for lazy Stripe initialization; updated four payment components to use the hook and added loading states; preserved loadStripeNow for backward compatibility.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The merge of main into the branch brought in many unrelated changes (Docker, env, docs, auth, etc.), inflating total diff lines; the core lazy-loading change is confined to the five listed primary files.
